# The PyCardano helper's environment: pycardano 0.19.2 and its runtime
# dependencies, each pinned exactly with the SHA-256 of every file PyPI
# publishes for that version, installed by scripts/build-helpers.mjs pycardano
# with --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all:.
#
# The dependency versions are those of PyCardano's own lockfile at its release
# (poetry.lock, main group, at Python-Cardano/pycardano 0445f30, tag v0.19.2),
# as pip 24.0 resolves pycardano==0.19.2 under them for CPython 3.12 on
# x86_64 Linux; the lockfile's packages for other platforms and Python
# versions (importlib-metadata, pyreadline3, pywin32, zipp) are not needed
# there. Every hash below equals the lockfile's for the same version. An
# unconstrained resolution (2026-11-13) takes cbor2 6.2.1, from which
# cbor2pure 5.8.0, which pycardano imports by default (pycardano/cbor.py),
# cannot import, so the library does not load.
